UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's custom profile and personal trivia progress statistics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

totalScore.description: Cumulative score earned across all completed trivia rounds.

totalCorrect.description: Cumulative number of correctly answered questions.

favoriteCategory.description: Most frequently played or favorite trivia category key.

streakFreezes.description: Saved Streak Freeze tokens (0-3) earned from leveling up, earning >=10000 XP in a day, or completing 3 daily objectives for 3 consecutive days.

lastActiveDay.description: Local calendar date key (yyyy-MM-dd) of last recorded daily check-in.

lastFreezeUsedDay.description: Local calendar date key (yyyy-MM-dd) when a Streak Freeze saved the streak.

dailyXpEarned.description: XP accumulated during dailyXpDate toward the daily Streak Freeze goal.

dailyXpDate.description: Local calendar date key (yyyy-MM-dd) corresponding to dailyXpEarned.

dailyXpFreezeGrantedDate.description: Date key when the daily high-XP Streak Freeze reward was granted.

objectiveDayKey.description: Local calendar date key (yyyy-MM-dd) for today's daily objective progress.

completedObjectiveIds.description: Scenario IDs (up to 3) completed on objectiveDayKey.

dailyRoundsCompleted.description: Number of trivia rounds completed on objectiveDayKey.

dailyObjectiveStreak.description: Consecutive days (0-3) completing all 3 daily objectives.

lastObjectiveCompletedDay.description: Most recent date key when all 3 daily objectives were finished.

objectiveFreezeGrantedDate.description: Date key when the 3-day consecutive objective streak Freeze reward was granted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

QuizSession.title: QuizSession
QuizSession.description: Immutable historical record of a completed trivia round for personal progress tracking.

difficulty.description: Selected difficulty filter for the round.

playedOffline.description: Whether the round was played from the offline Room cache.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when session was recorded.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard entry keyed by user UID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when entry was last updated.

WeeklyRankingEntry.title: WeeklyRankingEntry
WeeklyRankingEntry.description: Public weekly ranking entry scoped to a cycleId anchored at Sunday 12:00 PM GMT.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

cycleId.description: Sunday 12:00 PM GMT weekly cycle identifier (yyyy-MM-dd_1200Z).

weeklyXp.description: Weekly ranking XP earned during this cycle, resetting every Sunday 12:00 PM GMT.

highScore.description: Best single-round score in this weekly cycle.

gamesPlayed.description: Rounds completed in this weekly cycle.

correctCount.description: Correct answers in this weekly cycle.

answeredCount.description: Total answered questions in this weekly cycle.

bestStreak.description: Best answer streak in this weekly cycle.

level.description: Player's lifetime Explorer Level derived from cumulative lifetime XP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when weekly entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when weekly entry was last updated.

BattleRoom.title: BattleRoom
BattleRoom.description: Multiplayer trivia battle room keyed by 6-character room code containing host-selected topics and shared frozen questions.

roomCode.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching document ID.

hostUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

questionCount.description: Number of shared questions in the battle (5-20).

languageCode.description: Language code used to generate/select the shared question set.

memberUids.description: UIDs of players who joined the room (1-12).

questions.description: Frozen shared question list so all room participants face the exact same questions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when room was last updated.

BattleParticipant.title: BattleParticipant
BattleParticipant.description: Per-player live scoreboard state inside a battle room, keyed by participant userId.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the participant.

bestStreak.description: Highest streak achieved in this battle.

finished.description: Whether the participant has completed all questions in the battle.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of last progress update.

BattleInvite.title: BattleInvite
BattleInvite.description: Direct battle room invitation sent from a host to a signed-in friend.

roomId.description: Target BattleRoom document ID / room code.

hostDisplayName.description: Display name of the inviting host.

inviteeDisplayName.description: Display name of the invited friend.

questionCount.description: Number of questions in the battle.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when invite was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when invite was updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and personal progress metrics owned by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/quiz_sessions/{sessionId.description: Personal quiz history records nested under the owning user.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Global non-PII lifetime explorer directory indexed by userId.

/weekly_rankings/{cycleId}/entries/{entr.description: Weekly global ranking entries partitioned by Sunday 12:00 PM GMT reset cycle.

/battle_rooms/{roomId}.description: Multiplayer battle rooms keyed by 6-char roomCode with shared questions.

/battle_rooms/{roomId}/participants/{par.description: Live per-player scoreboard docs inside a battle room keyed by participant userId.

/battle_invites/{inviteId}.description: Direct battle room invitations from hosts to signed-in friends.
